snippet.title: Pitch & Power: Football Owner – Trailer
snippet.description:
Own the club. Build your career.

Pitch & Power: Football Owner puts you in the owner's chair. Run the whole business behind a football club: sign players, hire the coach, invest in local businesses, grow your stadium in 3D and follow every match in 3D highlights - from the bottom division to the top flight.

▶ Windows PC early beta - itch.io: https://ran6k.itch.io/pitch-and-power
▶ Android - Google Play: free to play with ads; a one-time unlock removes the ads and lets you play on from season three.
▶ Website: https://ran6k.games

Vince is an AI character. Voice and music made with AI tools.
Made by ran6k, an independent studio. Contact: ran@ran6k.games

#PitchAndPower #FootballManager #IndieGame #footballgame #management #simulator #gamesimulator #businessgame
